accepted_methods: Separate L/N/P/R stages, general versus runoff, regular/full/unexpired terms and cycle versus event year; do not join by state/year alone.
Use candidate rows without adding subtotal/control rows; preserve missing/zero/one and source-specific removal markers.
Unknown party/identity/class/date remains explicit blocked, never defaults to Other or a nominee. No winner-based selection.
Exactly one verified D/R candidate for conditional margin; keep others recorded/excluded, reject rival same-party aggregation.
Maintain33 frame slots and exclusions; no outcome-based replacements, imputation or sample shrinkage.
Same-publication summary sheets are internal consistency checks, not independent external evidence.
Alternative tabular source does not pass or reopen consumed Clerk/PDF/G03 scopes and does not complete House or advanced variants.

blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.AK: Keep nonpartisan identity unresolved unless explicit estimand amendment/accepted mapping; otherwise exclude.
blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.OR: Combined party label is one observed count; no split/double-count. Affiliation acceptance remains reviewed.
blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.ME: Round/stage provenance not supplied by a generic GENERAL VOTES header.
blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.GA: Full/special and November/January observations separate. Any conditional November regular-GEN use despite runoff needs protocol interpretation/amendment; combined summary composition needs explicit source evidence.
blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.LA: Multiple same-party participants cannot be converted into one nominee.
blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.AR: A missing-D situation, if confirmed, retains an ineligible frame slot; do not fabricate or replace.
blocked_adoption_conditions_preserved.all_states: Independent accepted class/term/date/candidate/source witnesses remain necessary before actual historical feature adoption. Current capture hash agreement alone is insufficient.
